**Summary**

Two roads are unusable: Panchakanya–Trishuli is closed and Galchhi–Myagang is flooded. Myagang temple isn't a designated drop-off point, so car2 only drives through it. The only valid drop-off points are Tarkeshwar shelter and Dupcheshwar hospital.

| Trip | Route | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| car1, trip 1 | Tarkeshwar → Trishuli → Naukunda → Trishuli → Tarkeshwar | 4 children | 114 |
| car2 | Dupcheshwar → Nilkantha → Myagang → Bidur → Tarkeshwar | 2 adults, 2 elderly | 61 |
| car1, trip 2 | Tarkeshwar → Galchhi → Syaphru → Galchhi → Tarkeshwar | 1 injured, 3 adults | 68 |

**Deferred people:** 2 adults at Syaphru and 6 at Panchakanya are deferred, for a penalty of 8 × 20 = 160.

**Why these adults are deferred:** a further trip to collect them doesn't pay for itself. The best option is Tarkeshwar → Galchhi → Syaphru → Panchakanya → Galchhi → Tarkeshwar, which takes 85 minutes. It would carry the 2 remaining Syaphru adults and 2 from Panchakanya, saving only 80 in penalties, so it adds 5 to the total cost.

I compared the main alternatives by hand rather than with an exhaustive solver, and this was the cheapest plan I found. It may not be the proven minimum.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter trishuli-temple
drive car1 trishuli-temple naukunda-school
load car1 child 4
drive car1 naukunda-school trishuli-temple
drive car1 trishuli-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 child 4
drive car2 dupcheshwar-hospital nilkantha-care-home
load car2 adult 2
drive car2 nilkantha-care-home myagang-temple
drive car2 myagang-temple bidur-village
load car2 elderly 2
drive car2 bidur-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car2 adult 2
unload car2 elderly 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter galchhi-village
load car1 injured 1
drive car1 galchhi-village syaphru-village
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 syaphru-village galchhi-village
drive car1 galchhi-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 adult 3
defer syaphru-village adult 2
defer panchakanya-farm adult 6
</plan>

Driving is 243 minutes (114 + 61 + 68), and adding the 160 penalty gives the total.

COST: 403
